goal: Preserve valuable distinct learned outcomes and reproducibility components for lawful independent research and offline use in case public distribution channels disappear; do not reproduce a general-model popularity leaderboard.
scenario: Hypothetical broad disappearance of public distribution, not a claim that every external copy has vanished or a ban is imminent.
selection_basis: task quality and documented negative evidence
incremental complete preservation cost and local resource efficiency
ordering_basis: research focus: controlled comparison of over-refusal and ordinary-task quality against matched base/instruct models; independent posttraining and weight-modification research; compact high-performance and specialist models
research focus: distinct architectures, modalities and underrepresented legitimate task capabilities
general models as baselines, dependencies or demonstrated capability complements
preservation decisions use independent technical value, documented actual distribution changes, reproducibility and cost; never rank by harmful capability or safety-control evasion
next_action: Run bounded research and close existing selected bundles; avoid broad discovery of redundant general models. Separate comparison-research priority from acquisition eligibility, and record the portfolio contribution.
